Yihong Zhao赵一红

I apply GeoAI and spatial data science to traffic safety and urban mobility. My research covers multi-source spatiotemporal data fusion, spatial heterogeneity and cross-scale modeling of road safety risk, driving and travel behavior, dynamic risk forecasting, proactive safety assessment, and data-driven traffic simulation.
